# Kebab House

> Kebab House is a demonstration restaurant website built with React and styled-components by Dawid Olko. It has one page with an interactive menu, desserts, a dish of the day and a live shopping cart.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kebab.dawidolko.pl/): the menu, desserts and cart

## Author

- [Dawid Olko](https://dawidolko.pl): Fullstack / AI Developer, author of this project
